description: Unleash the magic of motion with the Hover-1 Solaris – where every ride turns into a brilliant light show! Designed to captivate young adventurers, the Solaris features motion-activated multicolor wheel lights that dazzle as they glide, transforming ordinary outings into extraordinary experiences. Built for stability and comfort, the Solaris boasts larger front wheels and a lightweight frame that make every ride smooth and secure. The adjustable handlebar height and 110 pound weight capacity ensures Solaris grows alongside your kids, providing years of outdoor fun. Solaris is equipped with a dependable rear foot brake for quick and easy stops, and the sturdy solid wheels ensure smooth gliding over various surfaces. Let your child shine bright with the Hover-1 Solaris – the scooter that brings excitement, joy, and a splash of color to every journey. Perfect for children ages 3 and up, it's not just a scooter, it's their ticket to outdoor fun!
